1001.title: St. Agnes hall fair
1001.content: At the St. Agnes hall fair in 2011, Jules and I played draughts beside the cake stall. Jules lost a wooden counter, so we used a wrapped mint instead. Jules called it our emergency reserve. Afterward, we helped move folding chairs.

metadata.uncertainty: Attributed synthetic note; not independent historical verification.

1101.content: On a walk near Alder Park in 2008, Carys and I saw my red scarf blow onto a tree branch. Carys fetched a broom from the caretaker and lifted the scarf down. Carys called it our high-level rescue. We bought lemonade on the way home.

1201.title: Model-bridge display
1201.content: In 2003, Reza and I entered a model bridge in the St. Anne’s club display. Reza taped a teacup under one end when a leg broke. Reza called it the bridge with café service. We visited the library afterward.

1301.title: Seed-swap sign
1301.content: I helped Felix put up a sign for the neighbourhood seed swap in 2016. We fixed the arrow to the wrong edge of the board. Felix turned the board around rather than repainting it. Felix called it our reversible directions. Later we planted marigolds in two pots.
